sources.evidence_extract: Manufacturer-authored JSCJ PDF (every page footer www.jscj-elec.com, Rev. - 2.1; PDF creation date 2015-03-10) served by the JLC data-manual store for the exact catalog record; the unsigned asset path is recorded and the temporary signed retrieval URL is not. Same bytes for C14941 and C43490 and as the 2026-11-22 JST survey (sha256 fd5a910fc58737806f1596a6318cecd1e1264061e3ca7c6c7f13e69667e36ab5). Retained in Takazudo/circuit-dev-resources jscj/bzt52/bzt52c2v4-bzt52c43-sod-123-datasheet-rev-2.1-jlc-mirror.pdf (JLC-hosted copy of the JSCJ-authored PDF). Exact BZT52C11 row: type code WG, VZ 10.4..11.6 V at IZT 5 mA; ZZT 20 ohm max at IZT; ZZK 150 ohm at IZK 1.0 mA; IR 0.1 uA max at VR 8.0 V; temperature coefficient 5.4..9.0 mV/C at IZTC 5 mA. Maximum ratings Ta 25 C: PD 500 mW and RthJA 250 C/W (Note 1: 1 in2 FR-4, 2 oz copper, still air), VF 0.9 V at 10 mA, TJ/TSTG -55..+150 C. Marking: the marking bar indicates the cathode. Package page 4: body E 2.6..2.8 mm, D 1.5..1.7 mm, A 1.05..1.25 mm, E1 terminal span 3.55..3.85 mm, b 0.45..0.65 mm; suggested pad 0.8 x 1.0 mm at 3.24 mm centres.
